records.text: Abyss Points: Stigma Shards first (KeenGamer).
Belt +10 (Rare) cost: 232,000 Kina and 9,280 Enhance Stones.
Five Daevanion boards on global: {boardList}; node costs 1 / 2 / 3 / 4.
Cash shop: mostly cosmetic, but consumables and Daeva Pass materials exist (MassivelyOP, games.gg).
Daevanion points: 4 per level past 11 (checked at 16 and 17).
Duty Quests open at 45, 5 a day per server; Supply Requests (25) are a separate system.
Expedition weekly reward cap: 7 per dungeon (Metabot, KeenGamer) vs removed (games.gg; KR/TW).
Expeditions: Urugugu Canyon 28 (item level 300, party 2–5) and Fire Temple 35 (item level 500); Conquest at 45.
Free-to-play: the Market and the Kina/Quna exchange need the $15 subscription.
Skill points per level 30–44 (Wikily; 203 at 45 has two sources).

Regional quests: giver, Kibelisk, rewards, recommended and unlock level from each quest's Metabot page; prerequisites (an earlier regional quest or a story quest) from aion2.gaming.tools, cross-checked with allthings.how ({rqChained} follow-ups, {rqStoryGated} story-gated). Two gates with no permitted source are kept for an in-game check (Hugo Mercenaries: Deep Shadow).
Respec: free while you level; whether it costs Kina after 31 (MeinMMO vs allthings.how, ExitLag).
Sealed Dungeons are solo; every sampled band pays 2 Wisdom Stones + 2 crystals on the first clear (Metabot, allthings.how, AION2HUB).
Specialty slots at skill level 8 / 12 / 20, Daevanion nodes included (seen in your game); choices at 8 / 8 / 8 / 12 / 16 (Metabot skill pages).
Main story to "{storyEndQuest}" (Lv {storyEndLv}): objectives and Kibelisks from Metabot quest pages.
Stronghold level bands (zone plus the level range on Metabot's map).
Strongholds pay belt scrolls and Kina, no Wisdom Stones or crystals (Metabot quest pages, AION2HUB, allthings.how, FandomWire).
Supply Request details (request types, deadlines).
Unlock levels from the client-data table (Metabot, Wikily): enhancement 9; extraction, crafting, gathering 10; Supply Requests 25; daily dungeon 30; Abyss, Market, Ascension Trial, Conquest 45.
Command mission unlock levels.
